policy: Public domain or CC0 only, verified live at the Commons item page. CC-BY is not a public-domain dedication and this channel is monetised. Licence gate is research/imagery.pd_licence_ok, imported not reimplemented; the copyright-assertion screen is this module's own and differs from imagery.THIRD_PARTY on purpose - see the module docstring.

cocoa-butter-form-v.why: The form V crystal itself is seen only as a diffraction pattern or a polarised micrograph in copyrighted journal figures. The drawn cross-section device (visuals/food.py) stands in, and the narration says it is a drawing.

loaf-xray-tomography.why: Published X-ray tomography of a baking loaf is journal figures under copyright. The drawn cross-section device stands in.
